def fitness(self, width, height):
        """
        In guillotine algorithm case, returns the min of the fitness of all 
        free sections, for the given dimension, both normal and rotated
        (if rotation enabled.)
        """
        # get the fitness of all free sections, both normal and rotated
        # (if rotation enabled)
        free_sections = self.get_free_sections()
        # return the min of these fitnesses
        return min(free_sections.values(), key=lambda section: section.get_fitness(width, height))
